name: macos-cleanup-expert
description: macOS cleanup and dev-environment steward: scans 36 junk categories across macOS versions, cleans only after per-item confirmation with trash-based recovery, and diagnoses system vitals, Docker caches, leaked credentials and risky project-dir deletions.

displayName.zh: macOS 清理与开发环境管家

displayDescription.en: Scans and cleans macOS junk and dev caches to reclaim disk space, diagnoses system vitals, and audits risk before deleting — per-item confirmation, trash-recoverable by default.
displayDescription.zh: 扫描清理 macOS 垃圾与开发缓存释放空间，诊断本机工况；删除前逐项确认，默认进回收站可恢复。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先扫一遍我的 Mac，看看哪些垃圾能清、各占多大，别动手
defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan my Mac and show what junk can be cleaned and how big each part is — don't delete anything yet

quickPrompts.en: Scan my Mac and show what junk can be cleaned and how big each part is — don't delete anything yet
quickPrompts.zh: 先扫一遍我的 Mac，看看哪些垃圾能清、各占多大，别动手

quickPrompts.en: Clean npm, Python venv and Docker caches — ask me before each directory
quickPrompts.zh: 把 npm、Python 虚拟环境和 Docker 缓存清一下，每删一个目录先问我

quickPrompts.en: Show my CPU, memory, disk and network status
quickPrompts.zh: 看下本机 CPU、内存、硬盘和网络状况
